decided: In the brief, each judgement in the ledger names what it relies on (which requirement, ruling, goal, earlier answer or exploration decision) without quoting it. This entry also labelled a change's requirements as not yet synced whenever the brief is made before the archive records the sync, where D-br-4 had listed them as what the archive syncs; the proposal review later replaced that label with one that follows what the archive's run record says.
alternatives: quote the text of everything each judgement relies on, as the reading step's brief does
list the requirements in the copy the archive saves as what that archive syncs, as D-br-4 decided
why: The user signing off needs to know what each judgement rests on, and the reading step has already checked the wording against the quoted text; one label is true however the brief was made, while the command that saves it cannot tell whether the archive or a person ran it.
